tests.encoding: unit_encodePeerSharingV14ToLast, 100 generated SockAddr messages, all pass
tests.decoding: unit_decodePeerSharingV14ToLast, 100 generated messages each for NodeToNode v14, v15, and v16, all pass

upstream.randomness: The upstream cddl gem generates these cases from its entropy-seeded Random; the source property exposes no seed. Rows therefore retain version and generator ordinal, with seed recorded as unavailable rather than fabricated.

adapter.result: 300/300 original generated CBOR messages decode to Scarab typed PeerSharing values; every typed Scarab encoding decodes back to the same typed value

haskellCrossReplay.result: 300/300 original and Scarab-produced encoded messages were decoded by the pinned version-specific Haskell codec; typed PeerSharing message renderings (including full SockAddr lists) compared equal

adapter.originalWire: The fixture retains each original diagnostic term and exact encoded CBOR byte string. Scarab normalizes peer-list arrays: for example, upstream definite 82018183001a98c81904199db8 corresponds to Scarab indefinite 82019f83001a98c81904199db8ff. Exact encoded-byte identity is not claimed; the cross-replay confirms the pinned Haskell codec decodes both forms to equal typed messages.
adapter.limitations: bounded CDDL-generated SockAddr codec cases over v14-v16, not full Ouroboros-network protocol property suite coverage

schema: tab-separated cardano-peersharing-sockaddr-cddl-v1: version, ordinal, upstream status, diagnostic-term hex, original-CBOR hex
